example: Call the police if you see anything suspicious.

example: Can you tell me your exact address, please?

example: I wear headphones during calls to avoid the office noise.

example: Does this plan offer data rollover for unused gigabytes?

example: There is no mobile tower near our village.

example: Satellite phones work even in remote mountain areas.

example: I use about two gigabytes of data every day.
exampleTamil: நான் தினமும் சுமார் இரண்டு ஜிகாபைட் டேட்டா பயன்படுத்துகிறேன்.
